# Copilot Instructions for Commander_Wars

- This project is built using the CMake Tools Qt/CMake plugin, not by invoking `cmake`/`ninja` directly in the terminal.
- To build the project, use the command palette action `>CMake: Build` (accessible via the Visual Studio Code command line/command palette).
- Do not run raw `cmake --build` or `ninja` shell commands for building; prefer the `CMake: Build` command so the configured CMake Tools kit/build directory is used.
